grouping.union_rule: global union of exact normalised full prompts, extracted full stem+sorted complete choices, and identical extracted complete stems
grouping.limitation: Candidate grouping from released prompts, not official source item IDs; semantic paraphrases or unrecognised templates may remain unmatched. Identical generic complete stems with different choices can be conservatively overgrouped.

strict_five.selection_is_value_independent: Raw row counts, task categories, declared source/family inclusion and question text only; never correctness values or method performance.

target_definitions.published: Authors' released binary tensor; aggregation/missing-query semantics unresolved.
target_definitions.strict: Exactly one raw row per selected model/prompt and exactly one task category for the prompt; complete-case intersection is structural, not conditioned on labels.
target_definitions.unambiguous: Sensitivity only: agreeing raw labels within one category; exclusion depends on label values.

limitations: No raw model responses, evaluator revision, scoring-filter identifiers or generation status are published.
Singleton records are an auditable proxy; they do not recover upstream scoring correctness.
Published zero labels are not evidence that a missing query was answered incorrectly.
Retrospective structural inclusion is known for all released models; future model collection must enforce the same recording protocol.
Full raw support does not recover generation failure logs, metric/filter identity, or official upstream correctness.
Identical generic stems can be overgrouped; representative selection changes the target to a candidate-base-item representative subset.
